controls.title: The three lenses
controls.note: Watch the steepest angle as you move the sliders — it is what controls the blur.

sliders.label: Focusing power
sliders.help: How hard this lens bends the light. The three powers add up.

sliders.label: Shape
sliders.help: Bends the glass without changing its focusing power: 0 is equally curved on both sides.

task.title: Why one strong lens blurs the picture
task.description: On the left is an apple. The thin lines are light rays leaving two points on it, and the white square on the right is a screen, showing the picture that would really fall on it. Right now Lens 2 is doing all the focusing by itself. To bend the light that much in one go, the rays have to strike its surfaces very steeply — and a steep ray is always bent a little too much, so the rays miss each other and the apple arrives as a smear. Share the focusing between all three lenses instead. Each one then bends the light gently, the angles at the glass drop, and the picture comes together. The three powers must still add up to 3.43, and the apple must still fill the dashed outline.
task.hint: Try about 1.14 on each of the three power sliders, then slide the screen until the picture is sharpest and fills the dashed outline. Watch the steepest-angle meter as you go: it falls as you share the work out, and the blur follows it down. Two lenses are already enough to fix most of it. The Shape sliders are a second, smaller effect — they bend each piece of glass without changing how strongly it focuses.
task.successMessage: Three gentle bends instead of one violent one. Nothing about the glass got better — it is the same simple glass — but no ray is striking a surface steeply any more, and that is the whole difference between a smear and a picture. It is why a camera lens is a stack of elements and not one lump of glass.

goals.title: Keep the total focusing power at 3.43
goals.description: The three lenses together must still bend the light as much as the single lens did.

goals.title: Keep the apple filling the dashed outline
goals.description: Sliding the screen until the smear is smallest also makes the picture too small. It has to stay 1.4 times life size.

goals.title: Make the picture sharp
goals.description: How far one point of the apple is spread out by the time it reaches the screen.
